links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level of chatbot and Google responses to chronic disease queries
links.effect: GPT-3.5 grade level 14.69 ± 1.57 and GPT-4 12.88 ± 2.02, versus Bard 9.45 ± 1.35 and Google 9.92 ± 5.31; LLM outputs were less readable.
links.quote: However, Bard (9.45 ± 1.35) and Google responses (9.92 ± 5.31) had a lower average Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level compared to GPT-3.5 (14.69 ± 1.57) and GPT-4 (12.88 ± 2.02), indicating greater readability.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLM-generated health information compared to traditional search engines across chronic health queries, evaluated by physicians for accuracy, comprehensiveness, and readability.
